title: Carry-Over Usage Multiplier for the OTC Allowance
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — decision table.** The carry-over usage multiplier of a closed over-the-counter allowance quarter depends on how much of the amount loaded for that quarter the member spent.

**Rule.** The carry-over usage multiplier is one where the purchases tagged to the closed quarter reached at least three quarters (0.75) of the amount loaded for it, one half (0.5) where they reached at least one half (0.5) but less than three quarters of it, and zero where they reached less than one half of it. Where nothing was loaded for the closed quarter, the purchases are taken as having reached less than one half.

The carry-over usage multiplier scales the retained carry-over before the retained carry-over is limited to the quarter's unused allowance. *Hypothetical:* a retained carry-over of $20.00 before that limit, with a multiplier of one half, becomes $10.00 before that limit; with a multiplier of zero, nothing is retained.

### Decision table

| Purchases tagged to the closed quarter, as a share of the amount loaded for it | Carry-over usage multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0.75 or more | 1 |
| At least 0.5 and below 0.75 | 0.5 |
| Below 0.5 | 0 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, $50.00 loaded for the quarter)

| Purchases tagged to the quarter | Share of the load | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| $37.50 | exactly 0.75 | 1 |
| $37.49 | just below 0.75 | 0.5 |
| $25.00 | exactly 0.5 | 0.5 |
| $24.99 | just below 0.5 | 0 |

Purchases are the purchases tagged to the closed quarter in the allowance activity, whatever their channel.
